title: Tunisian Lemon Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful North African-inspired dish made with chicken, lemons, and spices in a rich and aromatic sauce, served over couscous.
instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chili peppers and garlic and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the lemon juice and bring to a simmer.
Cover the tagine and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped herb and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous, garnished with additional herb if desired.
